_comment: Eight-slot feature story for the 1.2 page. Same schema as screenshots.json (fastlane frameit's Framefile.json shape). Sources are the mk-* captures from VoyageUITests/MarketingCaptureUITests.swift. Build with: python3 scripts/make_app_store_screenshots.py --config AppStore/screenshots-1.2.json --out AppStore/screenshots-1.2

title.text:
Study for the length
of a flight.

subtitle.text: Pick a route. Look up when you land.

San Francisco to Los Angeles is 1h 25m.
To Seattle, 2h 05m.

title.text:
Pack what you will finish.
Then tear.

subtitle.text:
Two bags is two things
you get done this flight.

title.text:
See where you are
in the session.

subtitle.text: The plane moves as you work.
What you finish, and when.\nStays on your phone.

title.text:
Study hours count
toward a rating.

subtitle.text:
Three landings to solo.
Forty hours to private pilot.
One stamp for every flight you finish.
